name: Bloodcrave Hunt
text: Army marker for the Soulblight Gravelords Bloodcrave Hunt. Its battle traits, regiment abilities and enhancements are listed on the army.

name: Death's Descent
text: The Vargheists are not set up in the deployment phase: they start in reserve and arrive through Swoop Down.

name: Swoop Down
text: In your movement phase from battle round 3, set this unit up anywhere on the battlefield, every model more than 6" from every enemy unit.

name: The Hunger
text: Each time a friendly Vampire unit has fought, it heals as many damage points as its attacks allocated to enemy models.

name: Endless Legions
text: Once per battle, in your movement phase, pick a friendly Deathrattle Skeletons unit that has been destroyed. Set up a replacement unit of it with D6 models wholly in your territory, every model more than 6" from every enemy unit.

name: Ruinous Chargers
text: Once per battle, in any charge phase, pick your Blood Knights if they charged this turn. Each enemy unit they passed across in that charge suffers D3 mortal damage.

name: Vile Transference
text: Spell (casting value 6). In your hero phase, pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit. If the spell is cast, roll as many dice as that unit's Health characteristic: for each 5+, it suffers 1 mortal damage and this unit heals 1 damage.

name: Skeleton Legion
text: In your combat phase, roll a dice for each slain model of this unit. For each 6, return 1 slain model to it.

name: Riders of Ruin
text: Models of this unit can pass across enemy Infantry models as if this unit had Fly.

name: The Scent of Gore
text: Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit's attacks that target a damaged unit.

name: Grave-Sand Shard
text: Once per battle, when you use Skeleton Legion for a unit within 9" of the bearer, add 1 to each of its legion rolls.

name: Cloud of Bats
text: Once per battle, in your movement phase, take the bearer off the battlefield and set them up again anywhere, more than 6" from every enemy unit.

name: Aura of Night
text: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for shooting attacks that target the bearer.

name: Spirit Gale
text: Spell (casting value 7). In your hero phase, make a casting roll for the bearer. If it is cast, every enemy unit on the battlefield suffers 1 mortal damage.
